subject: [hw] V17 -> T01: wider differential result - 9 k04 scalar VFP kernels 180/180 in 3 configs
body:
Addendum with wider evidence for the rev-2 tree (commit 1a4034f), using a -O0 build of your diffrun + your loader + the host reference compiled from the same kernel sources:

  k04_float.c scalar kernels {k_faddsub,k_fmuldiv,k_fconv,k_daddsub,k_dmuldiv,k_dconv,k_fcompare,k_fround,k_fminmax} x 20 seeds:
    arm-O2      180/180 calls match
    thumb-O2    180/180
    armv8-O3v   180/180
  (k_fvec_loop/k_dvec_loop deliberately excluded: vectorized NEON, not scalar VFP.)

My own k_v17_fp.c kernels installed into a temporary arm-O2 lib: 9 kernels x 20 seeds = 180/180 match against the host reference too. So the file is ready for tests/emu/kernels/k17_v17_fp.c whenever you copy it.

Note the run used your 20-seed list and the arm-O2 libsupport.so; the class is the current tree emu/n2a32_vfp.c. If your next full run still shows a V17-attributed row, send me the kernel+seed+expected/got and I will open the trace.
